 Order
Learned APP for State, on instructions from the victim, submits that victim prays that a counsel be appointed to represent her in the present appeal.

2. Considering, the present appeal pertains to Section 376 IPC, Ms. Prachi Dubey, Advocate (Mob.
No. 9999191394) is appointed as Amicus Curiae (Pro bono) to represent the victim in the present matter.
The I.O shall provide a soft copy of the entire appeal paper-book to the learned Amicus Curiae and facilitate her in obtaining instructions from the victim.
3. The sentence of the appellant has already been suspended.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J DECEMBER 5, 2025 sn
